incidents.name: CS token outdated sellAmount global
incidents.notes: CS computes the burn amount from a stale global sellAmount variable rather than the current transfer, so the attacker repeatedly burned CS out of the liquidity pool and swapped the imbalance for USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: CS 0x8BC6Ce23E5e2c4f0A96429E3C9d482d74171215e created 2023-05-22T11:13:16Z by 0x0ea934e6653ab74e92be3ba1ea29b814c1a7fb46, unrelated to attack sender 0x2cdeee9698ffc9fcabc116b820c24e89184027ba; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 954,285.00 USDT left 0x6bc2823de2c3718d3669c2e7036e1d888c4107a1 and the attacker netted 714,285.00 USDT after repaying the 240,000 USDT flash loan.
